mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND occurrence_time >= #{startTime} AND occurrence_time < #{endTime}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert WHERE deleted = 0 AND alert_status = 'PENDING'

SELECT r.id, r.occurrence_time AS occurrenceTime, r.fault_type AS faultType, r.fault_description AS faultDescription, r.repair_result AS repairResult, r.completion_time AS completionTime, r.repair_hours AS repairHours, r.repair_priority AS repairPriority, r.responsibility_division AS responsibilityDivision, r.equipment_id AS equipmentId, r.staff_id AS staffId, s.name AS staffName, s.department AS staffDepartment, s.position AS staffPosition FROM maintenance_record r LEFT JOIN maintenance_staff s ON r.staff_id = s.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRecords, SUM(CASE WHEN repair_priority = '紧急' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergency, SUM(CASE WHEN repair_priority = '高' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high, SUM(CASE WHEN repair_priority = '中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium, SUM(CASE WHEN repair_priority = '低' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low, ROUND(AVG(repair_hours), 2) AS avgRepairHours, ROUND(SUM(repair_hours), 2) AS totalRepairHours FROM maintenance_record WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT fault_type AS faultType, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(repair_hours), 2) AS avgHours FROM maintenance_record WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY fault_type ORDER BY count ASC

SELECT r.id, r.occurrence_time AS occurrenceTime, r.fault_type AS faultType, r.fault_description AS faultDescription, r.repair_priority AS repairPriority, r.equipment_id AS equipmentId, s.name AS staffName FROM maintenance_record r LEFT JOIN maintenance_staff s ON r.staff_id = s.id WHERE r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.occurrence_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
